unwritten_consumer_rules.rule: Child delegation requires parent.delegation.may_delegate true and parent.remaining_depth strictly greater than child's remaining_depth. 'bounded depth' is described (AUTHORITY_CONTEXT.md:88-91) but strict decrement is not.
Grant issuer must match a 5-tuple (issuer, issuer_role, issuance_record_ref, institution_id, authority_domain) present in snapshot['issuers']; tuple shape is specified only by fixtures.

Status record must have grant_id==grant, revision==grant.revision, state=='active' and 0<=age<=snapshot.max_status_age_seconds (future-dated observations refused). Max age is described abstractly (AUTHORITY_CONTEXT.md:80-84, 125) but the future-timestamp refusal and exact field names are fixture-defined.

Required authorization evidence must be a snapshot fact with state=='satisfied', source_ref equal to obligation and effect_id equal to action.effect_id, age within max_age_seconds. The effect_id binding is not in AUTHORITY_CONTEXT.md.

Approval adequacy: state 'approved', role_id match, approver in approval_role_bindings, grant_id and grant_revision match, binding equals SHA-256 of sorted compact JSON of the action (AC:26-27), policy_versions equal grant's, validity window, independence via snapshot['independent_reviewers']. Binding recipe is documented as local fixture convention (AUTHORITY_CONTEXT.md:49-51), the rest is not enumerated.
Delegated grants must carry identical requirement.approvals, requirement.evidence and conflicts as the parent (strict equality); documented as 'conservative subset' (AUTHORITY_CONTEXT.md:96-100).

Bundle record ids must be globally unique across all six sections ('duplicate record id'); delegation parent_revision must equal the parent's current revision; each mutation's prior_revision must equal the authority's revision at that point. None of these three is stated in authority-lineage README (invariants 1-8 at README:20-29).

AuthorityUseLink.used_at must not precede commitment.resolution_time; a commitment older than a later effective mutation is stale (README invariant 4 covers staleness; the not-before-resolution ordering is only in code).

T4 consequence always refused as 'reserved_constitutional_process'; T2/T3 require non-empty requirement.approvals. Mentioned only in testing/fixtures/authority-context/README.md:47 as fixture coverage, not in AUTHORITY_CONTEXT.md.

unwritten_rules_method: Read authority_context.py and run_authority_lineage.py in full; for each distinct check grepped process/, docs/, testing/fixtures/authority-context/*.md and README.md for the field name or reason code (T4, remaining_depth, prior_revision, parent_revision, 'duplicate record', max_status_age, issuance_record_ref, principle_inspired). Rules marked unwritten had no match outside schema/examples/code. Not every research/ and history/ file was read. Note: these are checks on fixture/snapshot inputs; the repo enforces nothing on a live peer's output.

notes: Gov has no machine-consumed export carrying an ODES-style lifecycle. The only artifacts a decoupled ODES plan could bind to are the Authority Context 0.1.0 schema (stable between pin and main) and the lineage 0.1.0 schema (post-pin only; AuthorityUseLink links decision_id/effect_id).

Both interfaces are labelled proposed, pending Governor review, and say no cross-repository compatibility or ODES conformance is claimed (AUTHORITY_CONTEXT.md:156-157; AUTHORIZATION_EFFECT_CONTRACT.md:149-152; authority-lineage README.md:35-39). Any decoupling plan must not cite them as conformance evidence.

Moving the pin from fb3d9793 to main adds the lineage profile but leaves the Authority Context schema byte-identical; the runtime's ALVORADA_COMMIT constant (engine/safe_executor.py:18) is unused, so the pin has no executable effect there.

The snapshot/action shape the reference checker needs is defined by fixtures and code only; no schema (AUTHORITY_CONTEXT.md:144-146 states the caller must supply 'the reference fixture shape'); reference_errors may raise on malformed input (authority_context.py:46-52).
Hub component-lock.json is referenced by URL in README.md:26,32,69,114 but not present or validated here; CI only asserts two sha strings appear in README text (readme-guides.yml:26-27).
Local main (bae4bce) differs from the README's stated accepted main 89e4722b by the commits after it (e.g. f5b governance finalization #48, Counter/symlink/non-finite fixes); not an interface change.
